data.body:
[P2] Retain concurrency slots until item promises settle

`onTerminal` decrements `activeCount` and starts another item before the reported item finishes deserialization. Consequently, even `maxConcurrency: 1` can run all item deserializers concurrently, removing the previous bound on storage-backed serdes requests and memory. When resuming an unfinished batch, cached `ReplayChildren` items also report before reconstructing their bodies, allowing those child functions to overlap despite the limit. Keep terminal reports for completion decisions, but release concurrency slots and start additional items from `onSettled`. Add concurrency assertions covering slow item deserialization and incomplete-batch replay.
